name: Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-4B-v1.1

lifecycle.note: Open weights still downloadable from NVIDIA's Hugging Face organisation. NVIDIA has marked only its hosted API endpoint on build.nvidia.com as deprecated (see notes); no deprecation of the model weights was found.

sources.locator: Training Recipe for Llama 3.1 Nemotron Nano 4B v1.1

relations.note: NVIDIA's article on Nano 4B v1.1 refers to Llama 3.1 Nemotron Nano 8B v1 as the previous version.

summary.text: Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-4B-v1.1 is a 4B open-weights reasoning language model in NVIDIA's Llama Nemotron Nano line, fine-tuned from a Minitron-compressed Llama 3.1 8B base and also offered as an NVIDIA NIM. NVIDIA says it is small enough to run at the edge on Jetson and RTX GPUs; reasoning can be switched on or off through the system prompt.

changes.text: About half the parameters of Nano 8B v1: 4 billion instead of 8 billion.

sources.locator: Advancing Reasoning SLMs for On-device Agentic AI

changes.text: Built on Llama-3.1-Minitron-4B-Width-Base, which NVIDIA pruned and distilled from Llama 3.1 8B, instead of directly on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

sources.locator: How to Use Llama 3.1 Nemotron Nano 4B v1.1

features.note: Reasoning on or off is selected through the system prompt.

sources.locator: Function Calling with Llama 3.1 Nemotron Nano 4B v1.1

openWeights.note: Governed by the NVIDIA Open Model License; the Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement also applies (Built with Llama).

contextWindowTokens.note: The model overview also gives the context length as 128K.

sources.locator: Advancing Reasoning SLMs for On-device Agentic AI

access.note: Checkpoints on Hugging Face and an NVIDIA NIM on build.nvidia.com; NVIDIA has since marked the hosted API deprecated (no longer supported after 04/17/2026).

notes: Fine-tuned from NVIDIA's Llama-3.1-Minitron-4B-Width-Base, which NVIDIA created from Meta Llama 3.1 8B with Minitron pruning and distillation; that NVIDIA base model is not in scope and the Meta link is cross-organisation, so no derived-from relation is stored. No public v1.0 of a Llama Nemotron Nano 4B was found on NVIDIA's Hugging Face organisation; the name starts at v1.1. The model card gives the release date 5/20/2025; Hugging Face metadata shows the repository was created on 2025-05-03, and NVIDIA's introductory article followed on 2025-06-10. Hosted API: the build.nvidia.com page marks the endpoint nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-nano-4b-v1.1 deprecated on 04/17/2026; this concerns the hosted endpoint only, so the lifecycle follows the open weights, which remain downloadable.
